item.content:encoded:
The United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF), through the United Nations Volunteers (UNV) programme, is inviting qualified professionals to apply for the Communications Officer (Digital & Multimedia) National UN Volunteer assignment based in Suva, Fiji. This is an excellent opportunity for experienced communications professionals with strong digital media, storytelling, multimedia production, and social media management skills to contribute to improving the lives of children and young people across the Pacific region.

The assignment offers professionals an opportunity to work directly with UNICEF’s Communication Section, supporting advocacy campaigns, multimedia storytelling, digital communications, donor visibility initiatives, and audience engagement across 14 Pacific Island countries.

If you have experience in digital communications, content creation, photography, videography, multimedia editing, analytics, and strategic communication, this assignment provides a meaningful platform to apply your expertise while supporting one of the world’s leading humanitarian organizations.

About UNICEF

UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to protect the rights and wellbeing of every child. Its mission is to ensure that every child survives, thrives, learns, and is protected from violence, discrimination, and exploitation.

Within the Pacific region, UNICEF serves:

  • Cook Islands
  • Fiji
  • Kiribati
  • Marshall Islands
  • Federated States of Micronesia
  • Nauru
  • Niue
  • Palau
  • Samoa
  • Solomon Islands
  • Tokelau
  • Tonga
  • Tuvalu
  • Vanuatu

Together, these countries are home to approximately 2.3 million people, including 1.2 million children and youth, living across more than 660 islands and atolls spread over approximately 17.2 million square kilometres of the Pacific Ocean.

Several countries within the region—including Kiribati, Marshall Islands, Federated States of Micronesia, Solomon Islands, and Tuvalu—are classified as Fragile States under World Bank/OECD criteria, making UNICEF’s work particularly significant.

About the Communications Officer (Digital & Multimedia) Assignment

The Communications Officer (Digital & Multimedia) will be part of UNICEF Pacific’s Communications Section and will report directly to the Digital Communication Officer.

The Communications Section supports all UNICEF programme areas through strategic communication, advocacy, media engagement, branding, digital outreach, and social media campaigns.

The team also leads advocacy around four major regional priorities:

  • Violence against children
  • Climate action
  • Water security
  • Nutrition

The selected volunteer will help strengthen UNICEF’s digital presence, produce engaging multimedia content, enhance donor visibility, support youth participation, and amplify UNICEF’s advocacy messages through innovative storytelling.

Assignment Information

Item Details
Host Organization UNICEF
Volunteer Programme United Nations Volunteers (UNV)
Position Communications Officer (Digital & Multimedia)
Duty Station Suva, Fiji
Assignment Type National UN Volunteer
Volunteer Category Specialist
Work Arrangement Full-time
Work Location On UN Premises
Duration 12 Months
Extension Possibility Yes
Expected Start Date 24 August 2026
Number of Vacancies 1

Main Responsibilities

The Communications Officer will undertake a wide range of responsibilities covering digital communications, multimedia production, analytics, storytelling, advocacy, and volunteer engagement.

1. Digital Communication Planning and Publishing

The successful candidate will support UNICEF’s online communication strategy by:

  • Planning digital communication activities.
  • Producing digital communication materials.
  • Publishing content across UNICEF’s website and digital platforms.
  • Supporting social media campaigns.
  • Coordinating promotional campaigns.
  • Developing communication materials aligned with regional and global priorities.
  • Supporting donor visibility planning.
  • Coordinating production timelines.
  • Monitoring donor branding requirements.
  • Maintaining influencer and advocacy databases.
  • Supporting youth engagement initiatives.
  • Assisting online participation campaigns.

2. Multimedia Storytelling

A major component of the role involves creating compelling multimedia stories that demonstrate UNICEF’s impact.

Responsibilities include:

  • Producing social media reels.
  • Editing short videos.
  • Creating photo stories.
  • Designing graphics.
  • Preparing presentation assets.
  • Using existing photo and video libraries.
  • Capturing photographs during events.
  • Recording field missions.
  • Covering programme visits.
  • Documenting humanitarian activities.
  • Working with programme teams to identify impactful stories.
  • Simplifying complex development programmes into engaging public stories.
  • Coordinating interviews.
  • Supporting scripting.
  • Managing filming schedules.
  • Editing content.
  • Incorporating feedback.
  • Preparing final products for publication.

3. Ensuring UNICEF Brand Standards

The officer will ensure all communication materials comply with UNICEF standards by following:

  • UNICEF branding guidelines.
  • Ethical storytelling practices.
  • Child safeguarding policies.
  • Image consent procedures.
  • Accessibility standards.
  • Inclusion principles.

4. Digital Analytics and Performance Monitoring

The role also requires continuous monitoring of digital performance.

Responsibilities include:

  • Tracking engagement rates.
  • Monitoring audience growth.
  • Measuring reach.
  • Assessing impressions.
  • Reviewing click-through rates.
  • Preparing campaign performance reports.
  • Identifying successful content trends.
  • Testing new communication approaches.
  • Monitoring audience feedback.
  • Detecting misinformation.
  • Reporting reputational risks.
  • Supporting positive digital engagement.

5. Supporting the UN Volunteers Programme

As part of the assignment, the volunteer will also:

  • Promote volunteerism.
  • Participate in UN Volunteer activities.
  • Celebrate International Volunteer Day.
  • Produce annual volunteer reports.
  • Share field stories for UNV publications.
  • Mentor newly arrived volunteers through the Buddy Programme.
  • Encourage organizations to utilize UN Online Volunteering services.

Required Skills and Experience

Applicants should possess at least three years of professional experience in communications or related fields.

Essential competencies include:

  • Professional digital communications experience.
  • Social media management.
  • Multimedia editing.
  • Photography.
  • Videography.
  • Storytelling.
  • Graphic content production.
  • Copywriting.
  • Editing.
  • Proofreading.
  • Project management.
  • Organizational skills.
  • Communication planning.
  • Digital monitoring.
  • Analytics.
  • Teamwork.
  • Remote collaboration.
  • Strong interpersonal communication.

Candidates should also demonstrate commitment to UNICEF’s CRITAS values:

  • Care
  • Respect
  • Integrity
  • Trust
  • Accountability
  • Sustainability

Desirable Skills

Applicants with the following additional skills will have an advantage:

  • Digital analytics experience.
  • Canva.
  • Adobe Premiere Pro.
  • Adobe Photoshop.
  • Adobe Lightroom.
  • Adobe Illustrator.
  • Adobe InDesign.
  • Content Management Systems (CMS).
  • NGO experience.
  • UN experience.
  • Spreadsheet management.
  • Database management.
  • Technical writing.
  • Translating technical documents into public-friendly messages.

Educational Requirements

Applicants must possess:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in:
    • Communications
    • Journalism
    • Or another closely related discipline

Language Requirements

Applicants must demonstrate:

  • Fluent English (required)

Core Competencies

UNICEF seeks professionals who demonstrate:

  • Accountability
  • Adaptability
  • Flexibility
  • Building Trust
  • Commitment
  • Motivation
  • Continuous Learning
  • Communication
  • Creativity
  • Ethics
  • Integrity
  • Planning
  • Organizing
  • Professionalism
  • Respect for Diversity
  • Self-management
  • Technological Awareness
  • Teamwork

Areas of Expertise

Successful candidates should have experience in one or more of the following:

  • Communications
  • Public Information
  • Advocacy
  • Writing
  • Editing
  • Proofreading
  • Research
  • Reporting
  • Knowledge Management

Eligibility Criteria

Applicants must:

  • Be between 18 and 80 years of age.
  • Be a national of Fiji, a legal resident of Fiji, or hold refugee status in Fiji.
  • Have at least three years of relevant professional experience.
  • Meet the required educational qualifications.
  • Demonstrate fluency in English.

Living and Working in Fiji

The assignment is based in Suva, the capital city of Fiji.

UNICEF notes that:

  • Fiji is considered a middle-income country.
  • Basic services are readily available.
  • The country is widely recognized for its welcoming and friendly communities.
  • Volunteers are expected to arrange their own accommodation and living arrangements.
  • Standard personal security precautions should be observed.

Inclusivity and Equal Opportunity

UNICEF and the United Nations Volunteers programme strongly encourage diversity and inclusion.

Applications are welcomed regardless of:

  • Gender
  • Race
  • Religion
  • Nationality
  • Ethnicity
  • Disability
  • Sexual orientation
  • Gender identity
  • Language
  • Social origin
  • Pregnancy
  • Age

Reasonable accommodation is available for volunteers with disabilities throughout recruitment and during the assignment.

COVID-19 Requirement

Selected volunteers must generally provide proof of full COVID-19 vaccination with a World Health Organization (WHO)-endorsed vaccine before assuming duty, where applicable under UNICEF policies. Certain remote assignments or assignments without community interaction may be exempt according to UNICEF guidelines.

Scam Warning

Applicants should remember that:

  • The United Nations never charges application fees.
  • No payment is required at any stage of recruitment.
  • Applicants should be cautious of fraudulent recruitment schemes and only apply through official UN platforms.

Why You Should Apply

This assignment offers communications professionals an exceptional opportunity to:

  • Build experience within UNICEF.
  • Strengthen digital communication and multimedia production skills.
  • Work on high-impact advocacy campaigns.
  • Produce stories that improve children’s lives.
  • Gain exposure to international development communication.
  • Collaborate with experienced communication professionals.
  • Support youth engagement across the Pacific.
  • Develop expertise in donor visibility and digital analytics.
  • Contribute directly to UNICEF’s mission of protecting children’s rights.

APPLY HERE

Application Deadline

No application deadline has been specified in the vacancy information. Interested applicants are encouraged to apply as early as possible, as recruitment may close once a suitable number of applications has been received.

Visit HERE to learn more about the Communications Officer (Digital & Multimedia) at UNICEF Fiji.

Conclusion

The UNICEF Communications Officer (Digital & Multimedia) National UN Volunteer assignment presents an outstanding opportunity for experienced communications professionals in Fiji who are passionate about digital storytelling, multimedia production, and advocacy. Working within UNICEF’s Pacific Office, the selected volunteer will play a central role in creating compelling digital content that highlights the organization’s impact across 14 Pacific Island countries while strengthening public awareness of children’s rights and development priorities.

Beyond professional growth, this assignment provides the chance to contribute to meaningful humanitarian work, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, and support campaigns that influence policy, engage young people, and improve the lives of children throughout the Pacific region. Qualified candidates who meet the eligibility requirements are encouraged to submit their applications promptly through the official United Nations Volunteers recruitment platform.

For more global Job/Volunteering opportunities visit OFY HERE

item.content:encoded:
The Oppenheimer Memorial Trust (OMT) has officially opened applications for its prestigious Postgraduate Scholarships for students planning to begin their studies between January and June 2027. The Trust continues its long-standing commitment to developing exceptional academic talent by supporting outstanding scholars pursuing Master’s, Doctoral, and Postdoctoral studies in South Africa and, in exceptional cases, internationally.

The scholarship is designed for individuals with an exceptional academic record who aspire to make significant contributions to academia, scientific research, innovation, development, public policy, and other fields that advance knowledge and benefit society. Every year, the Oppenheimer Memorial Trust awards a limited number of highly competitive scholarships to scholars who demonstrate excellence, leadership potential, and a commitment to using their advanced education to contribute meaningfully to South Africa’s future.

Applications for students intending to commence studies between January and June 2027 are currently open and will close on 31 August 2026.

About the Oppenheimer Memorial Trust

The Oppenheimer Memorial Trust is one of South Africa’s leading philanthropic organizations dedicated to supporting higher education, research, youth development, and initiatives that strengthen the country’s knowledge economy.

Through its postgraduate scholarship programme, the Trust invests in future academics, researchers, innovators, and professionals whose work has the potential to address national and global challenges. The scholarship programme has supported numerous distinguished researchers and scholars whose work has gained international recognition across multiple disciplines.

The Trust believes that investing in highly talented individuals contributes directly to strengthening South Africa’s research capacity, universities, innovation ecosystem, and long-term development.

OMT Postgraduate Scholarship Programme 2027

The scholarship programme supports postgraduate studies at three academic levels:

  • Master’s Degree
  • Doctoral (PhD) Degree
  • Postdoctoral Research

Each year, only a limited number of scholarships are awarded, making the programme highly competitive. Successful applicants are expected to demonstrate exceptional academic achievement together with clear plans for using their education to contribute to research, teaching, development, or other knowledge-driven sectors.

International Study Opportunities

The Oppenheimer Memorial Trust also provides funding for international postgraduate study, although this opportunity is reserved only for exceptional candidates.

Applicants seeking international scholarships must demonstrate one or more of the following:

  • Their proposed programme is in a unique or highly specialized discipline that is not readily available in South Africa.
  • The intended international institution offers expertise unavailable locally.
  • Study under internationally recognized experts or global leaders will significantly advance their field.
  • International training will contribute meaningfully to their future academic or research career and ultimately benefit South Africa.

International scholarships are therefore considered only in exceptional circumstances and require strong academic justification.

Fields of Study

Applications are welcomed from all academic disciplines, ensuring that scholars from diverse areas of study have an opportunity to compete for funding.

However, the Trust specifically excludes:

  • Master of Business Administration (MBA) programmes
  • Doctor of Business Administration (DBA) programmes
  • Programmes with a narrow commercial focus

Apart from these exclusions, applicants across sciences, engineering, humanities, social sciences, medicine, agriculture, environmental sciences, education, arts, technology, law, and many other disciplines are encouraged to apply.

Who Should Apply?

The Oppenheimer Memorial Trust seeks applicants who demonstrate exceptional academic ability together with a strong vision for their future contribution to society.

Ideal candidates include individuals who:

  • Have consistently demonstrated academic excellence.
  • Intend to pursue careers in:
    • Academia
    • Research
    • Innovation
    • Development
    • Public policy
    • Related knowledge-intensive sectors.
  • Have well-developed postgraduate research plans.
  • Show the potential to become leaders in their disciplines.
  • Intend to use their expertise to strengthen research and development within South Africa.

Preference for Local Universities

Although international study is supported in exceptional cases, the Trust indicates that preference may be given to students pursuing postgraduate studies at South African universities.

This reflects the Trust’s commitment to strengthening local higher education institutions while still supporting international opportunities where clearly justified.

Scholarship Features

Successful scholars benefit from:

  • Funding for Master’s studies.
  • Funding for Doctoral (PhD) studies.
  • Funding for Postdoctoral research.
  • Possible international scholarship support for exceptional candidates.
  • Recognition through one of South Africa’s most prestigious postgraduate scholarship programmes.
  • Opportunities to advance academic and research careers.
  • Support for research that contributes to South Africa’s development.
  • Access to a respected network of scholars and researchers.

Selection Process

The Oppenheimer Memorial Trust follows a highly competitive selection process.

Applications are assessed based on:

  • Academic excellence.
  • Quality of the proposed study or research.
  • Potential contribution to academia and research.
  • Career aspirations.
  • Relevance and impact of the proposed programme.
  • Availability of specialized training where international study is requested.

Awards are made entirely at the discretion of the Trust’s Trustees.

Important Application Guidelines

Applicants should carefully observe all application requirements before submitting their applications.

Key guidelines include:

  • Applications must be submitted through the official online application portal.
  • Incomplete applications will not be considered.
  • Applications sent by email will not be accepted.
  • Only complete online submissions submitted before the deadline will be reviewed.
  • Scholarship awards are made solely at the discretion of the Trustees.

Failure to comply with these requirements may result in disqualification.

Application Timeline

For studies commencing January to June 2027

  • Applications Open: 1 June 2026
  • Application Deadline: 31 August 2026

For studies commencing July to December 2026

  • Applications Open: 6 January 2026
  • Application Deadline: 31 March 2026

Applicants targeting the January–June 2027 intake should ensure they submit all required documents before the 31 August 2026 deadline.

APPLY HERE

Additional Opportunities Offered by the Oppenheimer Memorial Trust

Beyond postgraduate scholarships, the Trust also offers several prestigious programmes, including:

  • Harry Oppenheimer Fellowship
  • New Frontiers Research Award
  • Sabbatical Study opportunities

These initiatives continue to support leading academics and researchers making significant contributions within South Africa and internationally.

Why You Should Apply

The Oppenheimer Memorial Trust Postgraduate Scholarship is among South Africa’s most respected postgraduate funding opportunities. Beyond financial support, it recognizes academic excellence and empowers scholars to pursue impactful research that addresses societal challenges.

Whether your ambition is to become a university lecturer, researcher, scientist, innovator, or policy expert, this scholarship provides an opportunity to access world-class postgraduate education while contributing to South Africa’s academic and research landscape.

If you possess an outstanding academic record, a well-defined research vision, and a commitment to advancing knowledge for public benefit, this scholarship represents an excellent opportunity to further your academic journey.

Prospective applicants are encouraged to prepare all required documents early and submit complete applications through the official online portal before the closing date.

Visit HERE for more information about the Oppenheimer Memorial Trust Postgraduate Scholarships 2027 in South Africa.

Conclusion

The Oppenheimer Memorial Trust Postgraduate Scholarships 2027 offer exceptional funding opportunities for talented scholars pursuing Master’s, Doctoral, and Postdoctoral studies. With support available across nearly all academic disciplines and limited international scholarships for outstanding candidates, the programme aims to cultivate the next generation of researchers, academics, and innovators who will contribute to South Africa’s long-term development. Since the awards are highly competitive and only complete online applications are considered, interested candidates should begin preparing their applications well in advance and submit them before 31 August 2026 for the January–June 2027 intake.

For more global Scholarship opportunities, visit OFY HERE.

item.content:encoded:
Higher education institutions seeking to strengthen international collaboration can now apply for the TNE Exploratory Grants 2026 under the Going Global Partnerships programme. The second round of funding offers 11 additional grants to support partnerships between institutions in the United Kingdom, Armenia, Bangladesh, and Thailand.

The grants aim to promote sustainable transnational education (TNE) partnerships that expand access to quality education, strengthen institutional collaboration, and contribute to positive change in local education systems.

About the TNE Exploratory Grants

The TNE Exploratory Grants support innovative projects that explore opportunities for transnational education partnerships while promoting inclusive and accessible international education.

The programme seeks to encourage institutions to better understand local educational contexts, develop sustainable partnerships, and contribute to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) through international education collaboration.

Grant Objectives

Projects should address one or more of the following objectives:

* Promote long-term and sustainable institutional change through Transnational Education (TNE).
* Increase access to high-quality and inclusive education.
* Improve understanding of local contexts and regulatory environments that support TNE partnerships.
* Strengthen operational frameworks for international education collaboration.
* Support education initiatives that respond to local needs and priorities.
* Contribute to positive changes in education systems and SDG achievement.

Funding Details

Grant Amount: Up to £25,000
*Project Duration: 17 months
*Project Start Date:  January 2027
* Number of Projects Funded: 11
* Programme: Going Global Partnerships
Participating Countries:  Armenia, Bangladesh, Thailand, and the United Kingdom

Eligibility Criteria

For Armenia and Bangladesh Partnerships

* The lead institution must be a UK higher education provider with degree-awarding powers.
* Partnerships should involve eligible institutions in Armenia or Bangladesh.

 For Thailand Partnerships

* The lead institution must be a Thai higher education institution.
* Partnerships should involve eligible UK institutions and meet programme requirements.

Applicants should consult the official Call Guidance document for complete eligibility requirements.

 Benefits of the Grant

Selected institutions will receive:

* Funding of up to £25,000.
* Opportunities to establish or strengthen international partnerships.
* Support for exploring sustainable TNE models.
* Enhanced institutional capacity for international collaboration.
* Opportunities to contribute to educational development and SDG-related outcomes.
* Greater understanding of local educational systems and regulatory frameworks.

Application Process

Applications must be submitted through the Going Global Partnerships online grant platform.

Armenia and Bangladesh Partnerships

Applicants should use:

Going Global Partnerships – Armenia & Bangladesh – TNE Exploratory Grants 2026

Applications can only be initiated and submitted by the lead UK institution.

Thailand Partnerships

Applicants should use:

Going Global Partnerships – Thailand – TNE Exploratory Grants 2026

Applications can only be initiated and submitted by the lead Thai institution.

Important Dates

Clarification Questions Deadline: 23 July 2026
Application Deadline: 2 September 2026, 11:59 a.m. BST
Project Start Date: January 2027

Why Apply?

The TNE Exploratory Grants provide an excellent opportunity for universities and higher education institutions to explore innovative international education partnerships. Beyond financial support, the programme helps institutions build long-term collaboration frameworks that improve educational access, quality, and sustainability across multiple countries.

Institutions interested in expanding their global engagement strategies and contributing to stronger international education systems should consider applying for this competitive funding opportunity.

How to Apply

Applications must be submitted through the Going Global Partnerships online grant platform before the deadline.

Application Deadline:  2 September 2026

Conclusion

The TNE Exploratory Grants: Round 2 offer an excellent opportunity for higher education institutions in the UK, Armenia, Bangladesh, and Thailand to build innovative international partnerships that can transform access to quality education. With funding of up to £25,000 per project, successful applicants will have the chance to explore new transnational education models, strengthen institutional collaboration, and contribute to more inclusive and sustainable higher education systems.

Beyond financial support, these grants provide a platform for institutions to deepen international engagement, improve understanding of local educational contexts, and develop initiatives that align with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). The programme encourages institutions to create long-term impact by fostering knowledge exchange, enhancing educational opportunities, and supporting positive policy and system-level changes.

If your institution is looking to establish or expand meaningful transnational education partnerships, this grant programme could be the catalyst needed to turn innovative ideas into impactful projects. Interested applicants should carefully review the eligibility requirements and application guidance before submitting their proposals ahead of the 2 September 2026 deadline.

Discover more opportunities like these on the OFY webpage.
